_about: isooctane (1) + methanol (2): the two liquids in equilibrium measured in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive's records (bulk file ThermoML.v2020-09-30.tgz), by validation/python/two_liquid_survey.py --classes (proposal 0019, step 2).
